# SCP.txt - SuperUnicode Control Plane layout (starter)
# The control plane is the machine-instruction registry of Base SUCS.
PLANE         00110000-0011FFFF   Control
RESERVED      00110000-0011A000   Future registry blocks
BANCODE       0011A000-0011A7FF   Unrecoverable critical panics, hardware faults, fatal exceptions
WARNCODE      0011A800-0011ABFF   Non-fatal telemetry; threshold alerts, degraded performance, predictive maintenance
COMCODE       0011AC00-0011ADFF   IPC events, bus orchestration, hardware handshakes, driver attachment, control plane signals
SOFTCODE      0011AE00-0011AEFF   Soft recovery, fault containment, cache reconciliation, self-healing routines
RESERVED      0011AF00-0011FFFF   Future control-plane blocks
